data:
@CategoryTheory.Adjunction.toEquivalence.{u_1, u_2, u_3,
    u_4} : {C : Type u_3} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_3} C] →
    {D : Type u_4} →
      [inst_1 : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_4} D] →
        {F : @CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} C inst D inst_1} →
          {G : @CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_2, u_1, u_4, u_3} D inst_1 C inst} →
            (adj : @CategoryTheory.Adjunction.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} C inst D inst_1 F G) →
              [∀ (X : C),
                    @CategoryTheory.IsIso.{u_1, u_3} C inst
                      (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_1, u_1, u_3, u_3} C inst C inst
                        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.id.{u_1, u_3} C inst) X)
                      (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_1, u_1, u_3, u_3} C inst C inst
                        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.comp.{u_1, u_2, u_1, u_3, u_4, u_3} C inst D inst_1 C inst F G) X)
                      (@CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app.{u_1, u_1, u_3, u_3} C inst C inst
                        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.id.{u_1, u_3} C inst)
                        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.comp.{u_1, u_2, u_1, u_3, u_4, u_3} C inst D inst_1 C inst F G)
                        (@CategoryTheory.Adjunction.unit.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} C inst D inst_1 F G adj) X)] →
                [∀ (Y : D),
                      @CategoryTheory.IsIso.{u_2, u_4} D inst_1
                        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_2, u_2, u_4, u_4} D inst_1 D inst_1
                          (@CategoryTheory.Functor.comp.{u_2, u_1, u_2, u_4, u_3, u_4} D inst_1 C inst D inst_1 G F) Y)
                        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_2, u_2, u_4, u_4} D inst_1 D inst_1
                          (@CategoryTheory.Functor.id.{u_2, u_4} D inst_1) Y)
                        (@CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app.{u_2, u_2, u_4, u_4} D inst_1 D inst_1
                          (@CategoryTheory.Functor.comp.{u_2, u_1, u_2, u_4, u_3, u_4} D inst_1 C inst D inst_1 G F)
                          (@CategoryTheory.Functor.id.{u_2, u_4} D inst_1)
                          (@CategoryTheory.Adjunction.counit.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} C inst D inst_1 F G adj) Y)] →
                  @CategoryTheory.Equivalence.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} C D inst inst_1

@CategoryTheory.Adjunction.comp_homEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4, u_5,
    u_6} : ∀ {C : Type u_4} [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_4} C] {D : Type u_5}
  [inst_1 : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_5} D] {E : Type u_6} [inst_2 : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_3, u_6} E]
  {F : @CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} C inst D inst_1}
  {G : @CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_2, u_1, u_5, u_4} D inst_1 C inst}
  {H : @CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_2, u_3, u_5, u_6} D inst_1 E inst_2}
  {I : @CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_3, u_2, u_6, u_5} E inst_2 D inst_1}
  (adj₁ : @CategoryTheory.Adjunction.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} C inst D inst_1 F G)
  (adj₂ : @CategoryTheory.Adjunction.{u_2, u_3, u_5, u_6} D inst_1 E inst_2 H I),
  @Eq.{max (max (max (u_4 + 1) (u_6 + 1)) (u_1 + 1)) (u_3 + 1)}
    ((X : C) →
      (Y : E) →
        Equiv.{u_3 + 1, u_1 + 1}
          (@Quiver.Hom.{u_3, u_6} E
            (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{u_3, u_6} E
              (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{u_3, u_6} E inst_2))
            (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_1, u_3, u_4, u_6} C inst E inst_2
              (@CategoryTheory.Functor.comp.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4, u_5, u_6} C inst D inst_1 E inst_2 F H) X)
            Y)
          (@Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_4} C
            (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{u_1, u_4} C
              (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_4} C inst))
            X
            (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_3, u_1, u_6, u_4} E inst_2 C inst
              (@CategoryTheory.Functor.comp.{u_3, u_2, u_1, u_6, u_5, u_4} E inst_2 D inst_1 C inst I G) Y)))
    (@CategoryTheory.Adjunction.homEquiv.{u_1, u_3, u_4, u_6} C inst E inst_2
      (@CategoryTheory.Functor.comp.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4, u_5, u_6} C inst D inst_1 E inst_2 F H)
      (@CategoryTheory.Functor.comp.{u_3, u_2, u_1, u_6, u_5, u_4} E inst_2 D inst_1 C inst I G)
      (@CategoryTheory.Adjunction.comp.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4, u_5, u_6} C inst D inst_1 E inst_2 F G H I adj₁ adj₂))
    fun x x_1 =>
    @Equiv.trans.{u_3 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_1 + 1}
      (@Quiver.Hom.{u_3, u_6} E
        (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{u_3, u_6} E
          (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{u_3, u_6} E inst_2))
        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_2, u_3, u_5, u_6} D inst_1 E inst_2 H
          (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} C inst D inst_1 F x))
        x_1)
      (@Quiver.Hom.{u_2, u_5} D
        (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{u_2, u_5} D
          (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{u_2, u_5} D inst_1))
        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} C inst D inst_1 F x)
        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_3, u_2, u_6, u_5} E inst_2 D inst_1 I x_1))
      (@Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_4} C
        (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{u_1, u_4} C
          (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_4} C inst))
        x
        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_2, u_1, u_5, u_4} D inst_1 C inst G
          (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_3, u_2, u_6, u_5} E inst_2 D inst_1 I x_1)))
      (@CategoryTheory.Adjunction.homEquiv.{u_2, u_3, u_5, u_6} D inst_1 E inst_2 H I adj₂
        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} C inst D inst_1 F x) x_1)
      (@CategoryTheory.Adjunction.homEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} C inst D inst_1 F G adj₁ x
        (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_3, u_2, u_6, u_5} E inst_2 D inst_1 I x_1))
